payload.title: Codex adapter
payload.description:
Purpose: extract human-authored messages from OpenAI Codex CLI rollout files at ~/.codex/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/rollout-<timestamp>-<uuid>.jsonl (CODEX_HOME honored; archived_sessions covered).

Scope: discovery walk of sessions and archived rollouts; extraction of user-role response_item messages (input_text blocks) with rejection of harness-injected user content (instruction/environment wrappers); never double-count event_msg user_message mirrors of response_item messages; session and project attribution from session_meta (id, cwd); dedup of forked/resumed rollouts using forked_from_id and forked_from_ordinal_exclusive (inherited messages count once) and of the same rollout in sessions plus archived_sessions by session_meta id; incremental watermarks. The codex CLI is open source, so format claims cite the openai/codex rollout source.

Done when: golden extraction tests pass on fixtures including mirrors, forks, archives, and malformed lines; a resumed rollout counts inherited human messages exactly once; doctor reports on a real Mac's roots.
